auditRole: independent source freshness execution audit; not team worker
timeBasis: UTC ISO-8601; per-file observations and before/after git timestamps; serial sampling, not atomic checkout freeze
samplingLimit: Two equal reads and unchanged HEAD/status/inventory detect sampled changes only; they cannot exclude transient edits or later edits.

acceptedSourceHash.recipe: SHA-256 exact docs/contracts/source-ledger.json captured provenance bytes, not live checkout

captureGenerations.overlay: explicit baseline + captured delta; historical composition, not atomic/current checkout

scopeHashRecipe: SHA-256 of UTF-8 (json.dumps([{repo,file,sha256}, ...], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + newline); source-ledger source/file order

classificationRules.matches: Regular-file live hash equals the selected frozen capture.
classificationRules.modified: Regular-file live hash differs from baseline or overlay, selected independently.
classificationRules.missing: The captured relative path does not exist in the live source.
classificationRules.new capture generation: Axis 1: one of the 23 already frozen delta overlays. Axis 2: an in-scope live path absent from the accepted baseline/overlay requires a future separately reviewed capture; no new source-deltas are created.
classificationRules.unreadable-or-excluded: Read error, symlink, or non-file is reported explicitly and never treated as a matching hash.

scope.capturedUniverse: Every baseline path and every explicit delta override, including excluded-from-runtime old bundles as evidence only.
scope.newPathDiscovery: Walk each recorded source scope using the recorded notCopied names, .env* prefix and no symlink traversal.
scope.gitDirtyCoverage: Whole repository status; not restricted to capture scope. Dirty counts include source paths outside migration scope.
limitations: No complete whole-repository content inventory for scrapyJs or todo-user-vue outside their recorded scopes.
Ignored files inside recorded scope are hash-inventoried unless excluded; git status does not enumerate ignored files.
No source fetch, commit, build, browser control, stash, reset, clean, sync, or source overwrite.

EXT-R01.bindingDecision: 02A creates singleton/focus/window shell using current source only as reference; no host owner/runtime.02B receives root ownership and adds authenticated RunHost registration/lifecycle, never concurrent authors.
EXT-R01.behavioralIntent: Independently implement toolbar open/focus, a singleton 800x600 tool window, explicit source identity, and recreation after removal.
EXT-R01.runtimeStatus: pending; this audit executes no EXT-T01 or product test
EXT-R01.warning: Behavior reuse intent does not authorize copying background.js, SDK/business bundles, legacy host ownership or execution paths.
